summary: Unapplied free-tier buffer caused mid-cycle negative invoice line and provisional charge
description: Issue summary: Customer reports they received a mid-cycle invoice with a negative line item and a provisional charge despite having an unused free-tier buffer. Impact: ShopWave flagged this as a finance/recurring-billing concern; it resulted in a temporary autopay hold and a customer invoice dispute. Environment: prod (us-east), enterprise account on dedicated capacity. Steps to reproduce (observed by Support): 1) Customer runs mixed streaming + batch workload using redwood-open-13B + rwd-embed-optimized-2B during UTC 2026-03-09 22:00-23:30. 2) Metering postbacks were processed; the postback-reconciler applied smoothing and quantized-rate mapping to hourly windows. 3) Free-tier buffer (monthly 1M token buffer for ShopWave) did not appear on the postback attribution for the affected hourly buckets. 4) Billing pipeline generated a provisional invoice that listed a negative line "Free-tier buffer: -$X.XX" and a separate provisional overage charge for the same window. Observed vs Expected: Observed a negative line and a compensating provisional charge; expected the free-tier buffer to be applied before any provisional overage is generated, yielding no negative lines and zero provisional charge. Attachments: customer-provided CSV of usage windows, screenshot of invoice, and postback payload sample (attached to ticket).
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Elena Martinez (Support): Created ticket after receiving invoice PDF and customer CSV. Noted immediate finance impact; requested provisional hold removal until investigation.
2026-03-10 12:40 - Owen Brooks (Billing Eng): Acknowledged. Asking for postback-run logs and the postback IDs from 2026-03-09 22:00-23:30. Assigned to billing triage queue.

2026-03-11 09:03 - Rachel Kim (Customer Success - ShopWave contact): Confirmed charges and attached an expanded ledger showing the negative line. Customer requests temporary waiver while we investigate.

2026-03-11 15:26 - Owen Brooks (Billing Eng): Found anomalies in hourly window bucketing; some postbacks landed in a "buffer-exclusion" namespace due to a tag mismatch introduced in last week's deploy (PR 838).
2026-03-12 08:55 - Finance (internal): Requested an interim credit equal to the negative line and asked for root cause ETA.
investigation_notes: Checked postback-reconciler logs for window 2026-03-09T22:00-23:00 and 23:00-24:00. Found 12 postbacks with tag 'free-tier' but reconciler matched them to 'tier-free' in mapping table, causing them to be excluded from buffer consumption calculations.

Query run: SELECT count(*) FROM postbacks WHERE account_id='shopwave' AND ts between '2026-03-09T22:00' AND '2026-03-09T23:30' returned 96 records; 12 had mismatched tag. Logs reference deploy-tag v2026.03.02-rc that modified tag normalization rules.

Cross-checked billing pipeline: quantized-rate mapper applied on top of smoothing; when buffer consumption is zeroed (due to exclusion), smoothing produced a negative adjustment line to reconcile previously-applied provisional credits.

Reproduced locally by replaying postbacks to staging reconciler with old and new tag normalization. Old behavior applied buffer correctly; new behavior excluded the tag. Linked PR 842 as a candidate fix.
resolution: Workaround applied: issued a one-off invoice credit for the negative line and cleared the provisional autopay hold for ShopWave (credited amount: $1,230.45). Long-term fix: rolled back the tag normalization change in postback-reconciler (hotfix PR #842 merged and deployed to prod 2026-03-12 21:00 UTC). Post-deploy validations: replayed impacted postbacks, buffer applied correctly and provisional charge removed in reprocessed draft invoice. Follow-ups: 1) Add unit test for tag-normalization mapping and postback namespace parity. 2) Add an alert for negative-line generation in billing pipeline to catch regressions. 3) Finance requested a short postmortem; one will be created and linked here once complete. Ticket remains In Progress until postmortem is filed and finance confirms closure.
